settings.text: About
Hi, I'm Adda. I make the templates I wish I had found.
A designer who got tired of losing track of invoices, then of meals, then of books. Each fix became a page, and the pages became this shop.
How it started
One spreadsheet too many

In 2020 I had a client list in one app, invoices in a spreadsheet and deadlines on sticky notes. I moved everything into one Notion page over a weekend, and for the first time I knew who owed me what without looking in three places.
That page became Freelance desk. The meal planner came next, because the same question kept coming up at six every evening. The rest followed from friends asking for the same kind of help.

Every template is tested on a real week before it goes on sale, and each one gets better as buyers write back.
